My wife and I have been using this app for over half a year now and I love that we can easily review all of our bank accounts, investments, and loans all in one place.  I previously managed all of this on my own before we found this solution and it’s so much better than having to share access or get her signed up to view all of the various accounts separately.  We use it for household budgets and retirement and vacation planning goals as well.  My only complaint is that you need to reverify your Amazon account almost daily.  We have a lot of purchases that come from there and if you want them to be properly sorted into the correct budget category you need to assign them when the come in.  That’s easy once they have been synced with Amazon, but it’s very annoying to have to sign in again and again so often.  Copilot is able to sync with very secure financial institutions, from our 401ks to our mortgage accounts, so it’s very surprising that there isn’t a more straightforward way to at least save the login information into the app of desktop portal to more easily sync itemized purchased made there.  It would easily be a 5-star experience if they could ever make that happen.

I love the interface because it’s colorful and easy to navigate. It’s so easy to categorize transactions and see where all of your money is. The rollover feature is perfect for me rather than having to track individual sinking funds. It didn’t take long to set up at all, and it shows me everything I need without having to run reports or search for it, such as the average amount I’m spending per category per month, which updates automatically. I’m switching from YNAB, and I hated the give every dollar a job model. In Copilot Money, you don’t have to move assigned dollars between categories every time money moves between your accounts. This app has given me the flexibility I need in my budget while still maintaining control over my finances. My one suggestion is to add an auto-distribute function for splitting transactions so I don’t have to manually calculate sales tax for each category.

EDIT: I have canceled my free trial and will be going back to spreadsheets. So far the customer support has been good. One of my accounts will not connect and they have been working diligently to resolve the issue - much appreciated. However, I discovered that a bunch of my transactions are missing. Initially, when I connected my accounts, it imported 2 1/2 years worth of data. I had to manually delete everything prior to this year, which was difficult because I kept trying to delete things and they wouldn’t disappear so I had to do it repeatedly. Now I’m discovering that most of my categories are missing transactions between January and April 2026. I tried entering them manually but it’s a bit tedious. I can’t customize the color of the accounts and when I search for them, the font is too small so it’s difficult to find the one I’m looking for plus they always come up in a different order. I also don’t like that I cannot re-order my categories or my recurrings. Speaking of recurrings, the app is not recognizing new transactions, even though I have set up a rule for the name. Some of my recurrings are duplicated and I can’t rename them. Visually the list is a mess. In addition, I have to agree with other users that there is no easy way to see what is available to spend. I find myself toggling back-and-forth between the cash flow tab, the dashboard and my categories but still not feeling certain about the information it’s giving me. Yesterday I was reviewing new transactions and one of them was categorized incorrectly even though I have at least five other transactions from the same place. When I re-categorized it, I found that all the previous transactions were also categorized incorrectly, even though I’ve already gone through every single transaction in my history and made sure that it was right. Somehow it got changed? I really like the layout of this app and at first it seemed great but now I’m finding too many functional errors.

The app imports all transactions from my bank as credits, including transactions where I’m paying someone else such as my power bill. This has been the case for most of 2026. Discussing the issue via the in-app support feature lead to agreement that the issue is present and then nothing, several months ago. Obviously my transactions showing as credits makes it nigh impossible to budget.

If you want to be able to see income-expenses=balance, this app isn’t for you. If you want a flashy dashboard that just shows how much you spent and you don’t really care to do the math, you’ll love it. If you’re actually budgeting, this is worthless. 
Update: I stand by my comments, the cash flow section is for the past, I want to also be able to budget for the future. I need the math on the budget.
